questions.question: Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option. Statement: The government has decided to implement stricter regulations on industrial pollution to curb the growing environmental concerns. Assumptions: I. Industrial pollution is a significant cause of environmental degradation. II. Stricter regulations will reduce industrial pollution. III. Environmental concerns are primarily related to industrial activities.
questions.questionHtml:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement:

The government has decided to implement stricter regulations on industrial pollution to curb the growing environmental concerns.

Assumptions:

I. Industrial pollution is a significant cause of environmental degradation.

II. Stricter regulations will reduce industrial pollution.

III. Environmental concerns are primarily related to industrial activities.

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
options.html: Only I and II are implicit

options.text: Only I and III are implicit
options.html: Only I and III are implicit

options.text: All I, II, and III are implicit
options.html: All I, II, and III are implicit

questions.solution:
I. Industrial pollution is a significant cause of environmental degradation – True (The decision to regulate industrial pollution assumes it significantly affects the environment).

II. Stricter regulations will reduce industrial pollution – True (Implementing stricter regulations assumes they will have the intended effect).

questions.question: In a row, Amit is 12th from the left and Sunil is 15th from the right. After they interchange their positions, Amit becomes 17th from the left. What is the total number of persons in the row?
questions.questionHtml: In a row, Amit is 12th from the left and Sunil is 15th from the right. After they interchange their positions, Amit becomes 17th from the left. What is the total number of persons in the row?
questions.solution:
Total persons = 17 + 15 − 1
= 32 − 1
= 31

questions.question: Complete the series. 1, 4, ___, 16, 25
questions.questionHtml:
Complete the series.

1, 4, ___, 16, 25
questions.solution:
1 = 1²
4 = 2²
? = 3² = 9
16 = 4²
25 = 5²

So, the missing number is 9.

questions.question: How many diagonals does a hexagon have?
questions.questionHtml: How many diagonals does a hexagon have?
questions.solution:
n × (n − 3) ÷ 2

= 6 × (6 − 3) ÷ 2

= 6 × 3 ÷ 2

= 18 ÷ 2

= 9

questions.solution:

After interchanging: (10 × 3) + 6 = 36

⇒ 30 + 6 = 36

⇒ 36 = 36

questions.question: If 'J' means '+', 'K' means '-', 'L' means 'x', and 'M' means '÷' || what is the value of the following expression? 20 M 4 L 3 J 5=?
questions.questionHtml:
If 'J' means '+', 'K' means '-', 'L' means 'x', and 'M' means '÷' || what is the value of the following expression?

20 M 4 L 3 J 5=?
questions.solution:
⇒ 20 ÷ 4 × 3 + 5
⇒ 5 × 3 + 5
⇒ 15 + 5
⇒ 20

questions.question: If + = ÷, - = x, x = +; then 12 + 4 × 2 - 3 = ?
questions.questionHtml: If + = ÷, - = x, x = +; then 12 + 4 × 2 - 3 = ?
questions.solution:
⇒ 12 ÷ 4 + 2 × 3
⇒ 3 + 2 × 3
⇒ 3 + 6
⇒ 9
